title: Building blocks
description: The pieces every shape is built from, each defined once here.

record_id.title: Record ID (UUID version 7, lower case)
record_id.description: A record's own ID. Made once by whoever writes the record, and never changed.

account_id.title: Account ID (UUID, lower case)
account_id.description: A Hrizzup account, by the ID our sign-in service gives it.

time.title: Time in UTC, like 2026-11-05T09:30:00Z
time.description: A moment in time, always in UTC, with up to six decimals on the seconds.

one_line.title: One line of plain text
one_line.description: Plain text on one line: no spaces at either end, and no control, direction or other invisible characters (the zero-width joiner inside some emoji is the one exception).

text.title: Plain text, new lines allowed
text.description: Plain text that may run over several lines: no spaces or new lines at either end, and no control (other than the new line), direction or other invisible characters (the zero-width joiner inside some emoji is the one exception).

web_address.title: Web address starting https://
web_address.description: A public web address. Shown as a plain link; our software never follows it on its own.

code.title: Short code (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens)
code.description: A short code that names something, made of lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens.

decimal.title: Decimal number, written as text, like 100000 or 97250.5
decimal.description: An exact number written as text, so no rounding creeps in: digits, then up to eight decimals after a full stop.

placeholder.title: ThumbHash, in base64
placeholder.description: A tiny blurred preview (a ThumbHash), made by our server at upload and shown while the real file loads.

media_key.title: File name in our media storage
media_key.description: Where the file sits in our media storage, never a full web address, so the same record works on staging and production.

image.title: Image
image.description: One image in our media storage, cleaned by our server at upload (location data removed, rotation fixed, size capped).

key.description: The image's file in our media storage.

width.description: Its width, so screens can hold its space before it loads.

height.description: Its height, for the same reason.

alt.description: What the image shows, in words, for people who can't see it.

placeholder.description: The blurred preview shown while the image loads, or if it never does.

video.title: Video
video.description: One video in our video service (Cloudflare Stream), which plays it at the quality each connection can carry.

stream_id.title: Video ID (32 lower-case hexadecimal characters)
stream_id.description: The video's ID in our video service.

width.description: Its width, so screens can hold its space before it plays.

height.description: Its height, for the same reason.

duration_seconds.description: How long it runs, in seconds.

alt.description: What the video shows, in words, for people who can't see it.

placeholder.description: The blurred preview shown before it plays.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Locations from the shared list, the main one first.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Categories from the shared list, the main one first.
